request.spec:
The header shows the signed-in user the due-totals of the people they watch, added up (0.00 when
watching no one).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The header shows the signed-in user the due-totals of the people they watch, added up (0.00 when
watching no one).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The header now shows the signed-in user a "Watched due" figure (`data-testid="watched-due-total"`): the due-totals of the people they watch, added up. It shows `0.00` when they watch no one, and people whose due is n/a are left out of the sum. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests.

This was a front-end-only change. The server already returns each user's watch list (`/api/sheets/{sheet}/watches?user=…`), so no server, data or audit changes were needed.

- **New `src/main/frontend/features/watch/useWatches.ts`:** I moved `useWatches` and `watchesKey` here from `watch.slot.tsx` so the header can share them. `watch.slot.tsx` now imports them and otherwise works as before.
- **`src/main/frontend/features/header/header.slot.tsx`:** reads the user's watch list, matches it against each person's due-total, and adds up the matches. I added a sentence about it to the header's doc comment.
